scientific_integrity: Exact probability bounds are prior work (arXiv:2211.01596); the claimed addition is the softmax-specific strict mixed-derivative sign, sharp cross-entropy optimum, and risk gap. Analytic proof is supported by reproducible finite tests only; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to a single output-logit rounding stage, not sequential conditional-mean-independent arithmetic.
For n>3 the (n-1)-wise-independence constraint is stronger than pairwise independence.
No top-1 accuracy, actual network inference, or floating-point implementation guarantee follows.
Equivalent unindexed general higher-order dependence inequalities might cover the analytic specialization.
scope: Simultaneous stochastic rounding of n>=3 softmax output logits, preserving every proper-subset Bernoulli joint law; no claim about operation-level arithmetic or trained-model accuracy.
title: Parity-optimal unbiased softmax rounding with unchanged lower-order moments
